original_query: Which is answered as the BARRIER to further AGILE ADOPTION by more respondents, Management support or Project complexity?

confirmed.answer_text: Management support is cited by 30% of respondents.; Project complexity is cited by 28% of respondents.
confirmed.summary: The page displays a pie chart illustrating the top barriers to further agile adoption, with percentages for each barrier. The most cited barrier is 'Inability to change organizational culture' at 53%, followed by 'General resistance to change' at 42%, and 'Trying to fit agile elements into a non-agile framework' at 35%. Other barriers include 'Management support' (30%), 'Project complexity' (28%), 'Customer collaboration' (25%), and 'Availability of personnel with right skills' (33%).
key_facts: Management support is cited by 30% of respondents.
Project complexity is cited by 28% of respondents.
